# FDG8001

> DO prefer using collections over arrays in public APIs. Section 8.3.3 provides details about how to choose between collections and arrays.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.1 Arrays.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Library only: the text scopes it to public APIs. Not an analyzer candidate: arrays are the better choice in low-level APIs (FDG8030) and for bytes (FDG8031), so whether an array parameter or return value should be a collection is judgment. CA1819 reports array properties (FDG8003, FDG8032). FDG8029 states the same preference in section 8.3.3.

public class Order {
  public Collection<OrderItem> Items { get { ... } }
  ...
}
